recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future valueUrl/valueUri questions should be handled under FHIR-32105/FHIR-31733 or release-history tooling rather than by changing current FHIR core source for FHIR-33161.
issue_request: FHIR-33161 was a Published/Persuasive R4B downloads issue. It reported profiles-types.json primitive StructureDefinitions deriving from an inaccessible PrimitiveType URL and profile JSON fhir-type extensions using valueUri instead of the long-standing valueUrl. The final resolution said the valueUrl issue was handled by other trackers and R4B references to the R5-only PrimitiveType construct would be reverted.
initial_application: No commit explicitly tagged FHIR-33161 was found. The applied state is visible in the current R4B history artifacts and published R4B download surface: tools/history/release4b/profiles-types.xml and https://hl7.org/fhir/R4B/profiles-types.json derive primitive definitions from Element, and R4B structuredefinition-fhir-type extension instances use valueUrl.
additional_context: PrimitiveType is now an active current-build abstract type registered in source/fhir.ini, documented on source/types.html, and defined by source/datatypes/primitivetype.xml. R5 profiles-types.json uses PrimitiveType for primitive baseDefinition and includes PrimitiveType derived from DataType, which is the correct R5+ shape. FHIR-32105 and FHIR-31733 cover the valueUrl/valueUri portion as separate final Jira decisions.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Reverting current PrimitiveType references would regress the active abstract type framework, while the R4B surface targeted by the issue is already corrected.

related_jiras.note: Published/Persuasive tracker that decided structuredefinition-fhir-type instances should use valueUrl and be corrected in profile files.
R4B fhir-type extension tracker that points to FHIR-32105 for the valueUrl/valueUri correction and separately handles the invariant.
